title: trading strategy,
author: Whole_Promotion6173
selftext:
If you have an NQ or MNQ trading strategy, I’d be happy to backtest it for free using historical NQ data.

The backtest will be done with no look-ahead bias and a proper Out-of-Sample (OOS) validation — no future data will be used to make decisions about the past.

I can provide results such as:

- Net P&L
- Win rate
- Profit factor
- Maximum drawdown
- Number of trades
- Equity curve
- In-sample vs. Out-of-Sample performance

Just send me your strategy rules:

- Entry conditions
- Exit conditions
- Stop loss / take profit
- Trading session
- Indicators or filters

100% free — no payment required.

If you have a strategy you’d like to test on historical NQ data, drop the rules below or DM me.
